en: The postcard shows a black and white photo of an industrial building under construction, with scaffolding around part of it and the surrounding landscape visible. In the foreground, trees and people, including children in old-fashioned clothing, can be seen. The top of the postcard has the text 'Wivstavarvs Sulfitfabrik, Fagervik, under byggnation.' The reverse side designates it as a postcard in both Swedish (Brevkort) and French (Carte postale), with the publisher information 'M. Sellman, Vivsta.'
